queries.sqlShape:
WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
       SELECT m.id,m.account_id,m.published_at,CASE WHEN s.event_generation>s.processed_generation THEN 0 WHEN s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'?') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT ?) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS priority,COALESCE(s.next_refresh_at,0) AS next_refresh_at
       FROM media m LEFT JOIN comment_media_state s ON s.media_id=m.id
       WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='?' AND m.published_at<=?
         AND COALESCE(s.unavailable_until,0)<=?
         AND (s.media_id IS NOT NULL OR m.published_at>?-720*3600000 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE account_id=m.account_id AND origin='?' AND status='?'))
         AND (s.media_id IS NULL OR s.next_refresh_at<=? OR s.event_generation>s.processed_generation OR (s.last_complete_at IS NOT NULL AND s.last_comments_count IS NOT (SELECT json_extract(metrics_json,'?') FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)))
) SELECT m.id,m.published_at AS publishedAt FROM candidates m
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='?' AND status='?')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE target_media_id=m.id AND origin='?' AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at>?)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs WHERE account_id=m.account_id AND target_media_id=m.id
           AND origin='?' AND status='?' AND started_at>=?)
       ORDER BY m.priority,CASE WHEN m.published_at>?-72*3600000 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,m.next_refresh_at,m.published_at DESC,m.id LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id FROM media m LEFT JOIN media_snapshots s ON s.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM media_snapshots latest WHERE latest.media_id=m.id ORDER BY latest.observed_at DESC LIMIT ?)
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type!='?' AND m.unavailable_until<=? AND (m.unavailable_code IS NOT NULL OR (CASE WHEN json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' OR json_extract(s.metrics_json,'?')='?' THEN 1
  WHEN instr(s.metrics_json,'?')>0 OR instr(s.metrics_json,char(92))>0
  THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(s.metrics_json) metric WHERE json_extract(metric.value,'?')='?') ELSE 0 END) OR COALESCE(s.observed_at,0) <= ? - CASE WHEN ?-m.published_at < 2*86400000 THEN 3600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 8*86400000 THEN 21600000 WHEN ?-m.published_at < 31*86400000 THEN 86400000 ELSE 604800000 END)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_runs r WHERE r.id=s.operation_id AND r.account_id=m.account_id
        AND r.kind='?' AND r.target_media_id=m.id AND r.status='?' AND r.started_at>=?)
      ORDER BY COALESCE(s.observed_at,0),m.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(m.published_at+86400000) AS expiry FROM media m
      WHERE m.account_id=? AND m.product_type='?' AND m.published_at>?-86400000
        AND COALESCE((SELECT observed_at FROM media_snapshots WHERE media_id=m.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT ?),0)<m.published_at+86400000-?
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_jobs j WHERE j.account_id=?
          AND j.origin='?' AND COALESCE(j.last_attempt_at,j.started_at)>?)
